# Smart Environment Group

Smart Environment Group provides property development, construction and property services across London, Hertfordshire and the Home Counties.

Core services include:
- Property development and development strategy
- Residential and commercial construction
- Design and build delivery
- Basement construction, extensions and loft conversions
- Commercial refurbishment and mixed-use development
- MEP, electrical, HVAC, security, data and smart building systems
- Planned maintenance, reactive maintenance and lifecycle property support

## Smart Environment Bathrooms

Smart Environment Bathrooms is our dedicated bathroom division, designing, supplying and installing complete bathrooms across London, Hertfordshire and the Home Counties.
Main page: https://seukltd.com/bathrooms/

Bathroom services:
- Bathroom fitters and installation: https://seukltd.com/services/bathroom-fitters-london/
- Full bathroom renovation: https://seukltd.com/services/bathroom-renovation-london/
- Luxury bathroom design: https://seukltd.com/services/luxury-bathroom-design-london/
- Wet room installation: https://seukltd.com/services/wet-room-installation-london/
- En-suites, small bathrooms and cloakrooms: https://seukltd.com/services/small-bathroom-cloakroom-london/
- Accessible and mobility bathrooms: https://seukltd.com/services/accessible-mobility-bathrooms-london/

Bathroom fitters by area include London, Hertfordshire, the Home Counties, Barnet, Camden, Islington, Westminster, Kensington and Chelsea, St Albans, Watford, Borehamwood and Elstree.
